items.standfirst: While blind boxes such as Labubus and Pokémon cards can be fun, experts warn parents should be aware of their similarities with gambling and help children create healthy habits around them.

clusters.neutral_headline: Skies go dark across Europe in once-in-a-lifetime total solar eclipse

items.title: Skies go dark across Europe in once-in-a-lifetime total solar eclipse
items.standfirst: From Spain to the UK, millions gathered to witness the sun's light be fully blocked by the moon in the continent's first solar eclipse in almost three decades.
items.content: From Spain to the UK, millions gathered to witness the sun's light be fully blocked by the moon in the continent's first solar eclipse in almost three decades.
